text:
cheng: Heads-up: starting a small pilot for automating 'access rolloff' — remove stale admin access and notify owners. Want to coordinate KMS admin churn, audit-log coverage, and vuln triage integration. Thoughts?

Tasha: SG. Do you mean auto-disable after 90d no activity? We tracked 120d earlier. :thinking:

cheng: Thinking 90d for admin/kms, 180d for read-only. We'll need to ensure CloudAudit logs don't drop events when we revoke keys. Also rotation of KMS keys — can we rotate without breaking active tokens?

kyle: @cheng we need to ensure key-rotation window overlaps with sessions. For AWS KMS you can have multi-key policy + alias swap, but tokens using previous encrypted blobs might fail. Let's run a canary in staging.

audit-bot: audit-bot: weekly access snapshot generated. 24 flagged admins (last_activity > 90d). Report: https://redwood.internal/audit/1782

irene: Also, vuln-triage flagged CVE-2026-0451 in third-party lib used by our on-prem KMS adapter. Before mass removing KMS admins, we should patch the adapter or isolate it.

andrew: Propose rollout: 1) generate report, 2) send owner slack action 1-click 'revoke/temp-suspend' for flagged accounts, 3) after 7d auto-suspend unless owner reasserts. Can we keep audit trail for the suspension actions?

Tasha: Audit logs can capture IAM changes. We should emit an 'redwood.access_rolloff' audit event from the orchestrator when action performed. Also record controller run_id.

cheng: Example request I had in mind:
```bash
redwood-admin access-rolloff run --policy=90d-admin --dry-run=true --notify-channel=#eng-security
```
Dry-run should not make changes but create audit entries.

kyle: Agree on dry-run. Also add 'kms-rotation-safe' check: for each key, ensure no active encrypted payloads within last 30d or have alias fallback.

irene: @kyle can you add the vuln-triage step to the preflight? If adapters are unpatched, fail with reason and link to vuln ticket.

audit-bot: audit-bot: noted. Creating ticket SEC-1327 to track automation, vuln check, and audit-log schema.

cheng: :thumbsup: I'll draft runbook and a short canary plan. Plan to schedule pilot next Wednesday 10:00 UTC. Volunteers for on-call during canary?

andrew: I'll take the canary slot. @Tasha handle rollback steps?

Tasha: On it. I'll add rollback snippet and a quick runbook entry in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/access-rolloff

cheng: Thanks all — will post the runbook + PR for the orchestrator job later today.
